resolution.summary: tf2_ros::Buffer::canTransform's polling loop no longer requires an initialised ros::Time: `now_fallback_to_wall()` (5e41627, released in 0.4.6) replaces ros::Time::now(), and `sleep_fallback_to_wall(const ros::Duration& d)` (0a034c5, merged as 001fca6, released in 0.4.8) wraps `d.sleep()` in `try { ... } catch (ros::TimeNotInitializedException ex) { ros::WallDuration wd = ros::WallDuration(d.sec, d.nsec); wd.sleep(); }` and replaces `ros::Duration(0.01).sleep()` in both canTransform overloads (tf2_ros/src/buffer.cpp). The consumer is unchanged.
resolution.evidence: jdddog, 2013-11-12: "Awesome, it works for me, thanks for fixing it!" after checking out geometry_experimental at the geometry_issue_30 branch (0a034c5, whose tf2_ros/src/buffer.cpp is byte-identical to 001fca6) as instructed by tfoote ("You will need to checkout geometry_experimental into your workspace from geometry_issue_30 branch"), running `listener.waitForTransform('camera_link', 'camera_rgb_frame', rospy.Time(), rospy.Duration(5.0))` through tf.TransformListener with the hydro binary tf (1.10.6 by release date).

resolution.summary: PR #333 (commit aa03e36, merged as 566092b): in tf2_ros/src/tf2_ros/buffer_client.py, __is_done no longer treats GoalStatus.SUCCEEDED alone as done; it returns True for SUCCEEDED only when self.client.get_result() is available, so __process_goal keeps polling until the result exists.
resolution.evidence: Diff of 566092b: '-           state == GoalStatus.SUCCEEDED or state == GoalStatus.LOST:' / '+           state == GoalStatus.LOST:' ... '+        if state == GoalStatus.SUCCEEDED and self.client.get_result():' / '+            return True' (https://github.com/ros/geometry2/commit/566092b42e3c42b4745294124762f8d7e5176716). The reporter re-ran his reproducer with and without the patch (2018-10-21): 'I went on, checked out the pr and reran my test with and without the patch. Without the patch the output given by the node is: ... [/tf_breaker ERROR 1540117570.008253]: The BufferServer returned None for result!  Something is likely wrong with the server. ... with the patch the output is: ... [/tf_breaker ERROR 1540118138.341125]: Received comm state ACTIVE when in simple state DONE with SimpleActionClient in NS /tf2_buffer_server ... From this short test I believe that the problem was partially mitigated. In fact, no more tf errors are thrown, however there is still something wrong with the tf state machine.' (https://github.com/ros/geometry2/issues/178#issuecomment-431658241). The failed condition of this composition (result unavailable after SUCCEEDED) is shown gone; the remaining actionlib state-machine errors were tracked separately in actionlib issue #116 and the check_frequency polling was replaced by wait_for_result() in PR #337 (commit fd68b57, merged 2018-10-29, released in 0.6.4). Caveat: the actionlib revision of the 2018 re-test is not stated; the units table keeps actionlib at the broken revision because the resolution does not change it.
